reason: I'd maybe try the free first collab because the café is someone I know, but I'm not paying for the pass. Hooking my Instagram up to a tiny beta app worries me, I already get campaigns on Influish, and making promo videos for 'participating businesses' just because I hold the pass sounds like free work.
objection: Giving a brand-new app access to my Instagram feels risky. Read-only or not, I don't know this team, and the café getting ₹150 when I buy makes the invite feel more like a sales pitch than a favour.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that the free collab actually lands me a paid local collab I wouldn't have got on Influish, and being told clearly that the promo videos are optional or paid.
